notes: tapFrac is normalised SCREEN space. UI taps are computed from the real RectTransforms over the 1242x2688 canvas reference with the AspectRatioFitter correction baked in: SafeArea fills the capture screen, but its child AspecterSA is FitInParent at aspect 1242/2688 = 0.46205 while the Unity AVD is 1080x2400 = 0.45, so the UI layer is 1080 x 2337.4, letterboxed 31.3 px top and bottom, and a UI rect at fraction u of the panel lands at 0.013039 + u * 0.973917 of the screen measured from the bottom (tapFrac y is 1 minus that). WORLD taps need no correction: the camera fills the screen, vertical extent is always 10 units, and the tray plaques for performance 1 sit at world (-0.735, -2.27) and (+0.735, -2.27), i.e. x = 0.339 / 0.661 and y = 0.727 from the top on both aspects. Which plaque is correct is generated per seed, so a tray tap lands either as a fragment snapping into the cast (jade flash) or as a miss (crimson shake) - both are visible feedback in frame. The pause pop is the deterministic result card, reachable at any time.
